name: Checkpoint save timing for Llama 3 8B: four checkpointers x two storage targets

tasks.name: every checkpointer writing to FSx for Lustre (/fsx, striped over every OST)
commands: for R in ckpt_dcp_sync ckpt_dcp_async ckpt_dcp_async_pinned ckpt_torch_checkpointing; do echo "== $R"; $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/run_variant.sh $R /fsx $OUT/fsx/$R || echo "[WARN] $R failed"; done

tasks.name: the same four against the local instance store RAID0 (/local), as the storage baseline
commands: for R in ckpt_dcp_sync ckpt_dcp_async ckpt_dcp_async_pinned ckpt_torch_checkpointing; do echo "== $R"; $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/run_variant.sh $R /local $OUT/local/$R || echo "[WARN] $R failed"; done

tasks.name: blocking time, write completion time and step time per variant
